events.name: Fremantle v Geelong Cats
events.selectedSentence: Fremantle's minor premiership now offers no safety net: Geelong brings its September run west for a single remaining path to a preliminary final.
events.fullSpiel: Nineteen home-and-away wins put Fremantle first, while Geelong entered September fifth after six consecutive wins. The published semi-final brings those different routes together in Perth. Both clubs now need this match to keep their premiership campaign alive; the double chance is gone.

events.name: Hawthorn v Western Bulldogs
events.selectedSentence: Hawthorn enter 8th and Western Bulldogs 6th; a late-season contest carrying finals-position pressure.
events.fullSpiel: Hawthorn are 8th with 8 points, while Western Bulldogs are 6th with 12. That makes this more than a date in Round 5: it is a late-season contest carrying finals-position pressure, with the next chapter shaped by the separation they create or erase.
